name: effect-fence-hold-input-vanished-untracked-path
description: HOLD reason `input_vanished`. The path is not in the tracked set, so the coordinator holds no record of it and builds comparands with current_version=None -- the vanish sentinel -- which the branch table answers on its FIRST leg. Pins the decision that the untracked exit is HELD and not fast-pathed: the pre-read twin answers {status: fresh} with no version here, and copying that would turn 'the coordinator knows nothing about this file' into 'the coordinator agrees nothing moved'. A regression that restored the fresh fast path, or that reached the same answer by MINTING the artifact row the way the first-observation branch does, turns this fixture red.
